name: 2N5401
description: PNP high-voltage (-150V) general-purpose amplifier, the standard complement to the NPN 2N5551. Common in high-voltage small-signal stages such as tube-preamp solid-state followers and CRT/Nixie driver circuits. TO-92 pinout is E-B-C (base center), the American convention.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-B-C left to right (base is the center pin).

typical_application: High-voltage PNP amplifier and level-shift stages where Vceo above 100V is needed; pairs with 2N5551 in complementary high-voltage circuits.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C (base center), the American convention; the reverse outer order from European C-B-E parts
Ic max is maker-dependent: onsemi rates -600mA, Fairchild only -200mA. Derate to 200mA to be safe across sources
PNP high-voltage: all ratings negative, do not exceed -5V Vebo or hFE degrades
the SOT-23 MMBT5401 has lower power and current ratings than the TO-92
